name: YBS
recent: YBS 近期公告集中在公司秘书与注册地址变更、董事及大股东 Yong Chan Cheah 的持股申报，以及 8 月 24 届常年股东大会结果更正。股东大会上 7 项普通决议通过，但特别决议 1 未获通过。
notable: 公司秘书出现变动，涉及 Ong Tze-En、Wong Yuet Chyn 与 Adeline Tang Koon Ling。
董事经理兼首席执行员 Yong Chan Cheah 在 11 月及 8 月多次申报增持公司股份。
risks: 特别决议 1 在 24 届常年股东大会上未获股东通过。
董事在闭门期 (closed period) 内进行股份交易并事先申报交易意向。

recent_en: YBS's recent announcements centre on changes of company secretary and registered address, shareholding disclosures by director and major shareholder Yong Chan Cheah, and a correction to the outcome of its 24th AGM in August. Seven ordinary resolutions were passed but Special Resolution 1 was not carried.
notable_en: Changes of company secretary involving Ong Tze-En, Wong Yuet Chyn and Adeline Tang Koon Ling.
Managing Director and CEO Yong Chan Cheah reported several acquisitions of shares in November and August.
risks_en: Special Resolution 1 was not passed by shareholders at the 24th AGM.
Directors traded shares during the closed period after declaring intention to deal.
